== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}} 
Rebecca was born about 1848. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2573|Joseph Glasgow]] and [[Gilbert-25488|Lucy Gilbert]].

On 26 Dec 1867, in Roanoke County, Virginia, she married Thomas Clark (1850-1918, son of Thomas/John Clark & Harriet Millner).<ref>'''Marriage''': "Virginia, Bureau of Vital Statistics, County Marriage Registers, 1853-1935", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:84CY-9CZM : Thu Jul 18 15:12:35 UTC 2024), Entry for Thomas Clarke and Thomas, 26 Dec 1867.</ref> They had the following known children.
#Kate Clark b. 1868 - d. aft. 1880
#Jennie Clark b. 1872 - d. bef. Feb 1899, m. John Lucas

She passed away in 1926, in Lynchburg, Virginia.<ref>'''Death''': "Virginia, Death Certificates, 1912-1987", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QVRW-3L49 : Mon Oct 13 19:55:08 UTC 2025), Entry for Rebecca Clark and Joseph Glasgow, 01 Mar 1926.</ref> She is buried at the Rivermont Cemetery.<ref>'''Burial''': Find a Grave, database and images (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/181499904/rebecca-clark: accessed November 4, 2025), memorial page for Rebecca Glasgow Clark (unknown–26 Feb 1926), Find a Grave Memorial ID 181499904, citing Rivermont Cemetery, Lynchburg, City of Lynchburg, Virginia, USA; Maintained by David Smith (contributor 48217285).</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2573]] is assessed at 97% (proved). The held accounts connect this child to Joseph Glasgow and Lucy Gilbert’s Roanoke family, citing the 1866 cohabitation register. Rebecca’s 1926 death index explicitly associates her with Joseph Glasgow, in addition to the reconstructed register family.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect 1866 row37 including children, then compare the child’s marriage/death parent fields.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QVRW-3L49 Death: "Virginia, Death Certificates, 1912-1987", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QVRW-3L49 : Mon Oct 13 19:55:08 UTC 2025), Entry for Rebecca Clark and Joseph Glasgow, 01 Mar 1926.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
